name: MSTN (myostatin)
summary: MSTN (myostatin), the best predictor of a Thoroughbred's best racing distance. At the variant g.66493737C>T, C/C horses are suited to short sprints, C/T to middle distances, and T/T to longer ones, with more stamina. The effect has been traced to an insertion in the gene. Shown in Thoroughbreds; it is a statistical tendency, not a guarantee for one horse.

phenotypes.name: Sprinter
phenotypes.description: Two C copies. Best suited to short sprint races.

phenotypes.name: Middle distance
phenotypes.description: One of each. Best suited to middle distances - the alleles do not hide each other.

phenotypes.name: Stayer
phenotypes.description: Two T copies. Best suited to longer races, with greater stamina.

citations.label: Hill et al. 2010, a genome-wide SNP-association study confirms g.66493737C>T in MSTN as the most powerful predictor of optimum racing distance (BMC Genomics 11:552)
